hypothesis: Round-1 iter4 (h4-echo-0075, GRPO+ECHO λ=0.075, 8 train tasks × 4 gens, lr=1e-5, rank 16/alpha 32) reproduces under round-3 eval-mode with the +0.1293 single-seed lift.
stage_transition_rationale: Round-3 pre-stage gate (NEXT_ROUND.md §Round-3 pre-stage gates): round-1 winners must be re-validated under round-3 eval-mode before being trusted as stage backfills. Per pi-faithful-completion precedent, round-1 numbers from single-seed evals tend to compress under 3-seed paired re-eval.
observations: iter4 produces +0.0394 paired lift at 2.70σ — REAL but ~3.3× smaller than round-1's single-seed +0.1293. The compression is consistent with round-1 single-seed variance, not round-3 eval-mode strictness.
iter4 SATURATES cross_file_caller_recall (1.0) and format_compliance (1.0) — both already at 0.944 baseline so headroom was small.
iter4 does NOT move invariant_coverage (0.375 vs base 0.370). The model still misses implicit invariants — that's the open frontier.
outcome lift +0.035 (0.754→0.789) is driven mostly by fields that ALREADY scored well at baseline; the hard fields (invariants, side_effects) remain weak.
Sigma 2.70 is below the 3σ ship threshold; lift 0.039 is below the 0.10 ship threshold. iter4 alone does not ship for round-3.
next_stage_implications: Stage 2 must target invariant_coverage and outcome.invariants — the residual headroom unmoved by iter4. SFT on synthesized ideal-from-gold (prep_sft_ideal.py) directly trains these. Two paths: (a) fresh SFT from base for clean signal, (b) SFT chained off iter4 to compound the +0.039 with whatever SFT adds. Path (a) is simpler; pick (b) only if (a) leaves <0.05 headroom.
